title: Independence of localized tensor cohomology models
statement: Let R,A,B,D be commutative rings with R-algebra structures on A,B and an A tensor_R B-algebra structure on D. Let M be any unbounded A-module complex, and m,n be universal base-derived tensor cohomology models as in [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model]. For each integer i there exists a D-module isomorphism from D tensor_(A tensor_R B) m.cohomology(i) to D tensor_(A tensor_R B) n.cohomology(i), whose forward map followed by n.localizedComparison(i) equals m.localizedComparison(i). No scheme, cartesian square, quasi-coherence, K-flatness of M, or flatness of D is assumed.

source.place: Independence of choices for derived change of rings; affine base-change cohomology calculation

proof.text: Uniqueness of universal left derived functors gives a natural isomorphism between m.derived and n.derived compatible with both counits. Compose its homology with the two cohomologyIso maps. Naturality at A-scalars and cohomologyIso_smul prove compatibility with the A action; B-linearity handles the B action. Tensor induction lifts the forward and inverse maps to A tensor_R B, and faithful restriction proves the inverse identities.

The prescribed values on pure tensors identify ordinaryIso and ordinaryToLocalized for both models. The universal counit equation and comparison_eq prove that the lifted isomorphism commutes with comparison. Extend it to D and transpose by extension/restriction adjunction; naturality and localized_eq then prove the localized comparison equation.

lean.statement: theorem baseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel_localized_independence (R A B D : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing D] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] [Algebra (A ⊗[R] B) D] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{u} R)] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{u} B)] (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (m n : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B M D) (i : ℤ) : ∃ s : (extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D)).obj (m.cohomology i) ≅ (extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D)).obj (n.cohomology i), s.hom ≫ n.localizedComparison i = m.localizedComparison i
